context: This criteria evaluates correct usage of the useSearch SWR hook from @vercel/commerce-commercejs for product search and filtering. It assesses proper hook parameter usage including search text, categoryId, and sort options, as well as correct handling of the found boolean and products array.

checklist.name: useSearch hook usage
checklist.description: The useSearch hook is imported from @vercel/commerce-commercejs and called with an input object

checklist.name: search parameter
checklist.description: The search prop is passed to the useSearch hook as the search field in the input object

checklist.name: categoryId parameter
checklist.description: The categoryId prop is passed to the useSearch hook as the categoryId field in the input object

checklist.name: sort parameter
checklist.description: The sort prop is passed to the useSearch hook as the sort field. Valid values include 'price-asc', 'price-desc', 'trending-desc', 'latest-desc'

checklist.name: found flag handling
checklist.description: When the hook returns found: false (or products is empty), the component renders a 'no products' message; when found: true, it renders the products list
